request.description: Add Legal Pages editor to web admin panel sidebar and remove version banner
request.prdContent:
# Requirements Document

## 1. Application Overview

**Application Name**: AdvoCal Admin Dashboard

**Description**: AdvoCal Admin Dashboard is a web-based administrative application for managing the AdvoCal Legal Calendar mobile app. It provides comprehensive tools for monitoring user activity, managing subscriptions, sending push notifications, analyzing data, and configuring application settings. The dashboard connects to the same Supabase database as the main mobile application and is optimized for desktop and tablet usage.

## 2. Users and Usage Scenarios

**Target Users**:
- System Administrators
- Platform Managers
- Customer Support Team

**Core Usage Scenarios**:
- Monitoring overall platform statistics and user activity
- Managing advocate accounts and subscriptions
- Sending push notifications to users
- Analyzing user behavior and subscription conversion
- Tracking case and hearing statistics
- Reviewing activity logs and admin actions
- Configuring application settings and subscription plans

## 3. Page Structure and Functionality

### 3.1 Page Hierarchy

```
AdvoCal Admin Dashboard
├── Login Page
└── Main Dashboard
    ├── Dashboard Overview (Default Home)
    ├── Advocate Management
    ├── Subscription Management
    ├── Push Notification Center
    ├── Analytics
    ├── Case Analytics
    ├── Activity Logs
    └── Settings
```

### 3.2 Login Page

**Functionality**:
- Admin login with credentials
- Validate admin role and permissions
- Navigate to Dashboard Overview after successful authentication

### 3.3 Dashboard Overview (Default Home)

**Statistics Cards Display**:
- Total Registered Advocates
- Total Active Users
- Total Paid Users
- Total Trial Users
- Total Expired Users
- Total Cases Added
- Total Hearings Scheduled
- Today's Hearings
- New Users This Month
- Revenue Summary

**Real-time Data**:
- All statistics connect to live Supabase database
- Auto-refresh data at regular intervals

### 3.4 Advocate Management

**Advocate List Display**:
- Display all registered advocates in table format
- Show advocate name, email, registration date, plan type, subscription status, case count

**Search Functionality**:
- Search advocates by name, email, or bar registration number

**Filter Options**:
- Filter by plan type: All, Free Trial, Premium, Expired
- Filter by subscription status: Active, Expired

**Advocate Profile View**:
- View detailed advocate profile information
- Display advocate name, email, bar registration number, chamber details
- Display subscription details: plan type, status, start date, end date, remaining days
- Display case count and hearing count
- Display team members list

**User Management Actions**:
- Suspend user account
- Reactivate suspended user account

### 3.5 Subscription Management

**Subscription Overview**:
- Display all subscriptions in table format
- Show advocate name, plan type, subscription status, start date, end date, remaining days

**Filter Tabs**:
- All Subscriptions
- Trial Users
- Paid Users
- Expired Users

**Subscription Expiry Tracking**:
- Display subscriptions expiring within 7 days
- Display subscriptions expiring within 30 days

**Revenue Reports**:
- Display total revenue
- Display monthly revenue breakdown
- Display revenue by subscription plan

### 3.6 Push Notification Center

**Send Notification Section**:
- Notification title input field
- Notification message input field
- Target audience selection: All Users, Selected Users, Trial Users Only, Paid Users Only
- Selected users multi-select dropdown (when \"Selected Users\" is chosen)
- Send immediately or schedule for later
- Schedule date and time picker (when \"Schedule\" is selected)
- Send button to dispatch notification

**Notification History Section**:
- Display list of sent notifications
- Show notification title, message, target audience, sent date and time, delivery status

### 3.7 Analytics

**User Activity Metrics**:
- Daily Active Users chart
- Monthly Active Users chart
- New Registrations chart
- User Growth chart (line chart showing growth over time)

**Subscription Conversion Statistics**:
- Trial to Paid conversion rate
- Subscription renewal rate
- Churn rate

**Most Active Advocates**:
- Display top advocates by case count
- Display top advocates by hearing count

### 3.8 Case Analytics

**Cases by Type**:
- Display total cases breakdown by case type
- Case types: Civil, Criminal, Family, Corporate, Tax, Other
- Show count and percentage for each type
- Display as bar chart or pie chart

### 3.9 Activity Logs

**Log Categories**:
- User Login Activity
- Case Creation Activity
- Subscription Activity
- Notification Activity
- Admin Action Logs

**Log Display**:
- Display logs in table format
- Show timestamp, user/admin name, action type, action details
- Filter by log category
- Filter by date range
- Search logs by user name or action details

### 3.10 Settings

**App Configuration Section**:
- Application name
- Application version
- Support email
- Support phone number

**Subscription Plan Management Section**:
- Display current subscription plans
- Edit subscription plan pricing
- Edit subscription plan duration
- Edit subscription plan features

**Trial Duration Settings Section**:
- Set trial duration in days
- Enable or disable trial period

**Notification Settings Section**:
- Configure default notification timing
- Enable or disable notification types

**Branding Settings Section**:
- Upload application logo
- Set primary color
- Set accent color

## 4. Business Rules and Logic

### 4.1 Admin Authentication and Authorization

**Admin Role Validation**:
- Only users with admin role can access the dashboard
- Validate admin permissions on login
- Redirect unauthorized users to login page

### 4.2 Real-time Data Synchronization

**Database Connection**:
- Connect to same Supabase database as main mobile application
- Fetch real-time statistics from profiles, cases, hearings tables
- Auto-refresh dashboard data every 30 seconds

### 4.3 User Suspension Logic

**Suspend User**:
- Set user account status to suspended
- Prevent user login to mobile application
- Display suspension reason

**Reactivate User**:
- Set user account status to active
- Allow user login to mobile application

### 4.4 Push Notification Delivery

**Target Audience Logic**:
- All Users: Send to all registered advocates
- Selected Users: Send to manually selected advocates
- Trial Users Only: Send to advocates with subscription_status = \"Free Trial\"
- Paid Users Only: Send to advocates with subscription_status = \"Premium\"

**Scheduled Notifications**:
- Store scheduled notifications with target date and time
- Dispatch notifications at scheduled time

### 4.5 Statistics Calculation

**Total Registered Advocates**: Count all records in profiles table

**Total Active Users**: Count profiles with subscription_status = \"Free Trial\" or \"Premium\"

**Total Paid Users**: Count profiles with subscription_status = \"Premium\"

**Total Trial Users**: Count profiles with subscription_status = \"Free Trial\"

**Total Expired Users**: Count profiles with subscription_status = \"Expired\"

**Total Cases Added**: Count all records in cases table

**Total Hearings Scheduled**: Count all records in hearings table

**Today's Hearings**: Count hearings with hearing_date = current date

**New Users This Month**: Count profiles with signup_date in current month

**Revenue Summary**: Sum of all subscription payments

### 4.6 Activity Log Recording

**Log User Actions**:
- Record user login events
- Record case creation events
- Record subscription changes

**Log Admin Actions**:
- Record admin login events
- Record user suspension/reactivation actions
- Record notification sending actions
- Record settings changes

## 5. Exceptions and Edge Cases

| Scenario | Handling |
|----------|----------|
| No advocates registered | Display empty state with message \"No advocates registered yet\" |
| No active users | Display zero count in statistics card |
| No subscriptions | Display empty state in Subscription Management |
| No notifications sent | Display empty state in Notification History |
| No activity logs | Display empty state in Activity Logs |
| Invalid admin credentials | Display error message \"Invalid credentials\" |
| Unauthorized access attempt | Redirect to login page with error message |
| Database connection failure | Display error message \"Unable to connect to database\" |
| Push notification delivery failure | Display error message and log failure |
| Empty notification title or message | Display validation error and prevent sending |
| No target audience selected | Display validation error and prevent sending |
| Invalid date range in filters | Display validation error |
| No data for selected date range | Display empty state with message \"No data available for selected period\" |

## 6. Acceptance Criteria

1. Admin logs in successfully with valid credentials and reaches Dashboard Overview
2. Admin views real-time statistics showing Total Registered Advocates, Total Active Users, Total Paid Users, Total Trial Users, Total Expired Users, Total Cases Added, Total Hearings Scheduled, Today's Hearings, New Users This Month, and Revenue Summary
3. Admin navigates to Advocate Management and views list of all registered advocates
4. Admin searches for a specific advocate by name and views advocate profile details
5. Admin navigates to Subscription Management and views all subscriptions with filter tabs
6. Admin navigates to Push Notification Center, enters notification title and message, selects \"All Users\" as target audience, and sends notification successfully
7. Admin navigates to Analytics and views Daily Active Users chart and User Growth chart
8. Admin navigates to Case Analytics and views total cases breakdown by case type
9. Admin navigates to Activity Logs and views user login activity and admin action logs
10. Admin navigates to Settings and updates trial duration to 10 days

## 7. Out of Scope for Current Release

- Multi-admin role management with granular permissions
- Two-factor authentication for admin login
- Export data to CSV or Excel
- Advanced analytics with custom date ranges and filters
- Email notification integration
- SMS notification integration
- Automated subscription renewal reminders
- Refund processing interface
- Invoice generation for subscriptions
- Bulk user import/export
- API key management for third-party integrations
- Webhook configuration for external services
- Custom dashboard widgets
- Dark mode theme
- Mobile responsive design optimization
- Multi-language support
- Audit trail with detailed change history
- Scheduled reports generation
- Data backup and restore functionality
- User feedback and support ticket management
- In-app messaging with advocates
- Payment gateway integration for manual subscription activation
- Subscription plan A/B testing
- Automated user segmentation
- Marketing campaign management
- Referral program tracking
- Advocate performance scoring
- Case outcome tracking and statistics
- Court-wise hearing statistics
- Judge-wise case statistics
